title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
gist: Apple ML Research (November 2026 paper) presents Depth Pro 2, a single scalable network that estimates dense metric depth at native resolution for both images and video, claiming to break the prior trade-off between temporal consistency (multi-frame methods) and boundary sharpness (single-frame methods). Apple releases code and weights for a model family it says sets a new Pareto frontier across metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency and runtime.

insights.claim: Apple's analysis of prior monocular depth estimation methods finds they trade off temporal consistency against boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency while single-frame methods favor sharpness.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Frames the key technical bottleneck in video depth for AR/robotics/camera pipelines; a model that removes it changes which approach vendors adopt.
insights.quote: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness
insights.locator: By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation

insights.claim: Apple's Depth Pro 2 is a single scalable network that processes both still images and video and predicts metric depth maps at the input's native resolution, designed to overcome the consistency-versus-sharpness trade-off.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Unifying photo and video depth in one model simplifies deployment in camera, spatial-computing and 3D capture products.
insights.locator: To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network

insights.claim: Apple claims Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp and temporally consistent simultaneously, outperforming prior work on all of these dimensions.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: If benchmarks hold, Apple sets the state of the art in metric video depth, raising the bar for competing 3D perception stacks.
insights.quote: metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions
insights.locator: Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate

insights.claim: Apple is releasing code and weights for a family of Depth Pro 2 models that it says define a new Pareto frontier across metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency and runtime.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Open weights let third parties (robotics, AR, video tools) adopt Apple's depth stack, commoditizing metric depth estimation.
insights.quote: We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier
insights.locator: We release a family of models

insights.claim: Depth Pro 2 estimates per-pixel depth in meters from an ordinary camera, with one network handling a single photo, a whole video, or a live camera feed at full input resolution.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Live-feed metric depth from a standard camera reduces reliance on dedicated depth hardware such as LiDAR for 3D sensing use cases.
insights.quote: One network handles a single photo, a whole video, or a live camera feed, at the input’s full resolution.
insights.locator: Depth Pro 2 estimates the depth of every pixel, in meters

insights.claim: Apple's original Depth Pro (October 2024, ICLR) was a zero-shot metric monocular depth foundation model producing a 2.25-megapixel depth map in 0.3 seconds on a standard GPU without needing camera intrinsics metadata.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Shows a sustained Apple investment line in metric depth; Depth Pro 2 extends it from single images to video.
insights.quote: producing a 2.25-megapixel depth map in 0.3 seconds on a standard GPU
insights.locator: October 9, 2024 ... foundation model for zero-shot metric monocular depth estimation

insights.claim: Apple's related SHARP work (ICLR) regresses a 3D Gaussian scene representation from a single photograph in under a second via one feedforward pass on a standard GPU, renderable in real time for photorealistic nearby views.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Together with Depth Pro 2, signals Apple building a single-camera 3D capture and view-synthesis stack relevant to spatial computing.
